annotation.authors_or_issuer: UKRI Gateway to Research (EPSRC); Principal Investigator Ingmar Posner, University of Oxford
key_provisions_or_claims: EPSRC programme grant of about £5.99m (Feb 2021–Jan 2027) to Oxford for embodied intelligence in robots.
Flagship applications in social care, manufacturing, logistics, precision farming and inspection with industry partners.
Responsible innovation via the EPSRC AREA (Anticipate-Reflect-Engage-Act) framework.
Aims to address trust and acceptance and the impact of automation on employment.
Lists outreach and engagement activities and publications.
annotation.summary_en: UKRI Gateway to Research project page for the EPSRC Programme Grant (EP/V000748/1) led by Oxford on embodied intelligence in robots. It describes research aims, industry flagships in care, manufacturing, logistics, farming and inspection, funding, partners, publications and outreach. Governance content is limited to responsible innovation (AREA) commitments.
annotation.title_clean: From Sensing to Collaboration: Engineering, Exploring and Exploiting the Building Blocks of Embodied Intelligence - An EPSRC Programme Grant
